text_block_list.text:
While on my way back home with<n>Biwa Hayahide,
we're stopped by<n>someone calling out to us.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey! Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good timing! We were just looking<n>for more
players. Come play<n>hide-and-seek with us!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Play with us!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must decline. I didn't come here to<n>play. We just
happened to pass by<n>on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on! This is our last round, I<n>promise!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: It'll be fun! Pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The last kid who joined us hasn't<n>had a chance to
play at all yet. Just<n>think of this as your good deed
for<n>the day!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's almost curfew... Oh, all right.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is it all right if we—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is it all right if we—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you, and sorry for dragging<n>you into this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Teio, which child hasn't<n>had a chance
to play yet?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Me! I didn't play yet. Thank you for<n>joining us!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, aren't you polite? Now then, I<n>have a request
for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to hide with me? I<n>have an idea I
want to try.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: An idea?
And so, the game of hide-and-seek<n>begins.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hayahide and the other girl<n>are the only
ones left.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can't believe they outlasted me.

text_block_list.name: Garoto A
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? That girl usually stinks<n>at
hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: And she always asks to play with uswhen it's too late. We'll have toinvite her right away for our games ifshe's actually this good!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
Five minutes pass...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Found them!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! You got us!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! We wouldn't have been able<n>to stay hidden
so long without you.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No! It's because of what you<n>taught—oh! I gotta
keep that a secret!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you don't have to. It'll be more<n>fun if you tell
everyone so they can<n>try it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just be sure to join everyone before<n>it gets dark,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Okay!
Everyone goes home with big smiles<n>on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm glad she grasped the trick so<n>quickly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, my sister and I were<n>considered
the best hide-and-seekers<n>around back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And I'll be happy to show you why!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha! Let's do this! Let's hide,<n>everyone!
And so, the game of hide-and-seek<n>begins.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: First place to check—under the slide!

text_block_list.name: Garoto A
text_block_list.text: Gah! You got me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Next, the trees next to the bench!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: What? How'd you find me so quick?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And now to find Teio...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There you are, up in the tree behind<n>my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon! There's no way you<n>could've known I
was here!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I merely factored in the size and<n>number of kids
and playground<n>equipment to narrow down my
choices. Well, did everybody have<n>fun?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

With a look of great satisfaction on<n>her face, Biwa
Hayahide heads back<n>to the dorms with Tokai Teio.
